text:
viv: Quick postmortem follow-up  two similar canary regressions. Need a short, tracked remediation: strict initial gate, atomic gate evaluation, and clear owners.

mira: Agreed. Propose owners and deadlines in-channel so we can close this quickly. Also require pre-rollout model-compat checks.

sam: Concrete proposal: initial gate 0.25% hold 5m; progress only if error_rate <= baseline+3pp AND p95 <= baseline+150ms AND schema_fail_rate < 0.1%. Auto-rollback on any fail. Global canary cap 2.5%.

toni: I'll own rollout-controller changes and the "no model swap" enforcement. ETA infra PR: Wed EOD.

viv: I'll own the tracking card INF-9999 and PM follow-up. Adding checklist items: PRs link, runbook, smoke CI. Deadline: tests by Tue EOD, infra review Wed, staged rollout Thu.

mira: I'll own dashboards + runbook. Will publish exact queries and on-call mapping (pager for sev2+, slack for sev3). Runbook will include manual-override policy (2 approvers) and evidence collection steps. ETA Wed noon.

sam: I'll implement rollback rule wiring and the smoke harness (golden prompts + schema + 500 synthetic tokens). PR ETA Tue. Harness will block progression on failure and post results to INF-9999.

viv: Draft gatekeeper config (to commit):
```
gatekeeper:
  initial: 0.25%
  hold: 5m
  progression: [1%, 5%, 20%]
  max_canary_total: 2.5%
  required_signals: [error_rate, p95_latency, schema_ok]
  thresholds:
    error_rate_delta: 0.03
    p95_delta_ms: 150
    schema_fail_rate: 0.001
  eval_window: 3m
  auto_rollback: true
```

mira: Add pre-rollout checks: tokenizer checksum, model pin, and run model-diff on canary slice. Also enforce no binary swap during rollout window.

toni: I'll add circuit-breaker tagging so canary failures don't cascade into shared caches/downstream. Also add an automated kill-switch that infra can flip in emergencies.

sam: Smoke harness will publish artifacts (logs + failing examples) to INF-9999 when aborts happen for faster triage.

deploy-bot: INF-9999 created by @viv; canary plan queued: gatekeeper-playbook/v1 scheduled 2027-01-08 02:00 UTC.

viv: Recurring pattern note: last 5 incidents show tokenizer mismatches and uncoordinated model swaps. Ticket requires pattern table + mitigation rows. We'll revisit thresholds after 3 clean gated rollouts.

mira: Once PRs and runbook are linked to INF-9999 we can consider relaxing initial blast radius for low-risk internal tests. For prod keep defaults strict. :thumbsup:
